reasons: dev-only evidence cannot make a release decision

limitations: The main CLI requires a separately provisioned commands.db and model cache; their tree digest is recorded and setup/download is outside this gate.
Warmed-query samples use fresh CLI processes after filesystem/model caches are warmed; the CLI has no persistent query-server mode.
Example IDs are mapped from user-visible description/command pairs in the pinned candidate bundle; unmapped output is conservatively scored as not acceptable.
Peak memory depends on the host time implementation; missing samples make the performance gate inconclusive.

warmed_query.process_scope: fresh CLI process per sample; filesystem/model cache warmed

protocol.primary_outcome: user-visible displayed example IDs and abstentions

retrieval_configuration.abstention: raw distance cutoff 0.60 plus scoped negation and unsupported-intent guards
retrieval_configuration.example_selection: retain same-page candidates in the top-k; display the top three after reranking
retrieval_configuration.fusion: dense candidate pool reranked by 0.05 per shared lexical token
query_rewrites: non-Windows file searches with an extension or filename pattern map to the corpus wording Find files by extension
Windows move requests that imply distinct drives map to the corpus wording Move a file or directory across drives
retrieval_configuration.ranking: raw cosine distance minus 0.05 per shared query/candidate token
